name: coordinator-lens
description: Makes the coordinator's work visible and calm: budget color and pace, workers, merges, the round, the skill flow, night mode and decisions, in a band above the prompt, a /coord pane and card, and a few toasts. It observes only and spends nothing.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the text you see (the text the model reads is always English).

planLine.title: Plan line
planLine.description: Fallback for the 'Claude plan:' line of your CLAUDE.md, for example: Max 20x · reserve 10% · banked: weekly reset, expires 2026-10-22. Leave empty to read it from CLAUDE.md.

prPolling.title: Pull request polling
prPolling.description: Run `gh pr list` every 5 minutes to show open pull requests and their checks.

stalledMinutes.title: Stalled after (minutes)
stalledMinutes.description: A running agent or workflow with no activity for this long is shown as stalled.

contextLine.title: Budget line for the model
contextLine.description: Add one hidden budget line to a prompt when the color, profile, 5-hour pause or weekly 5-point bucket changed.
